customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash)

full_name.meaning: customer's legal full name exactly as on the government-issued identity document; for a real estate agent, the licensed name

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile belongs to a mortgage borrower or to a licensed real estate agent who works with Larkspur on behalf of buyer clients

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number on the profile, used for contact and as an identity credential

email.meaning: email address on the profile, lower case, used for e-disclosure delivery and as an identity credential

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth on the profile; identity credential for borrowers, left empty for real estate agent profiles

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the borrower's Social Security number; identity credential for borrowers, left empty for real estate agent profiles

re_license_number.meaning: state real estate salesperson or broker license number exactly as issued (e.g. SAL.2019004871); identity credential for real estate agents, left empty for borrowers

mailing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the current mailing address on the profile; identity credential

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was created at Larkspur

loan_file_id.meaning: primary id of the mortgage loan file (one application for one property)

customer_id.meaning: primary borrower who owns the file (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: loan program the file is underwritten under, written as the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle status of the loan file (basis: loan lifecycle.states)

occupancy.meaning: how the borrower will occupy the subject property

units.meaning: number of dwelling units in the subject property (1 to 4)

property_address.meaning: street address of the subject property exactly as on the purchase contract or title

property_state.meaning: state where the subject property is located

base_loan_amount.meaning: loan amount before any financed upfront program fee (FHA upfront MIP or VA funding fee)

loan_amount.meaning: total note amount = base loan amount plus any financed upfront program fee

property_value.meaning: value used for loan-to-value: the lower of purchase price and appraised value for purchases, the appraised value for refinances

credit_score.meaning: representative credit score of the file (lowest middle score among borrowers)

dti_ratio.meaning: total debt-to-income ratio of the file as last underwritten

borrower_count.meaning: number of borrowers on the application whose credit is pulled

first_time_homebuyer.meaning: whether every borrower on the file is a first-time homebuyer (no ownership interest in a home in the past 3 years)

homebuyer_education_completed.meaning: whether a homebuyer education certificate is on file

qualifying_income_pct_ami.meaning: qualifying annual income of the file as a whole-number percentage of the area median income of the property's census tract

census_tract_income_level.meaning: FFIEC income level of the subject property's census tract

funding_fee_exempt.meaning: VA files only: the veteran receives VA service-connected disability compensation and is exempt from the VA funding fee; false on every other program

hpml_flag.meaning: whether the file's APR exceeds the average prime offer rate by the Regulation Z higher-priced mortgage loan threshold

escrow_waived.meaning: whether the borrower elected to waive the tax and insurance escrow account

seller_concession_amount.meaning: total contribution toward the borrower's costs agreed by the seller or builder in the purchase contract

agent_concession_amount.meaning: total contribution toward the borrower's costs agreed by a real estate agent out of commission

application_date.meaning: date Larkspur received all six TRID application items (name, income, SSN, property address, estimated value, loan amount)

intent_to_proceed_date.meaning: date the borrower's intent to proceed was received; empty until then

contract_closing_date.meaning: closing date written in the purchase contract; empty for refinances

estimated_closing_date.meaning: closing date currently scheduled on the file

suspended_date.meaning: date the file last entered suspended status; empty if never suspended

resubmission_count.meaning: number of times the file has been resubmitted to underwriting from suspense

preapproval_id.meaning: pre-approval the application was converted from (foreign key -> preapprovals); empty if none

agent_customer_id.meaning: buyer's real estate agent working with the borrower (foreign key -> customers); empty if none

prepaid_fee_balance.meaning: application and credit report fees paid by the borrower before closing and not yet refunded or applied at closing; equals the sum of the borrower_paid_fees account deltas

tolerance_cure_balance.meaning: tolerance cure owed to the borrower and not yet paid; equals the sum of the tolerance_cure account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the loan file was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the file reached a terminal status (consummation, withdrawal, denial or closure for incompleteness); empty while open

loan_fee_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the fee ledger entry

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file the fee belongs to (foreign key -> loan_files)

customer_id.meaning: borrower who paid or is credited (foreign key -> customers)

fee_code.meaning: which up-front fee the entry concerns

amount.meaning: entry amount, always positive; whether it adds to or removes from the prepaid fee balance is given by event_type

borrower_count.meaning: number of borrowers whose credit was pulled for a credit report fee entry; 0 on other entries

entry_date.meaning: date the charge, refund or closing application was booked

payment_method.meaning: how the money moved: the card or account charged/refunded, or a credit line on the Closing Disclosure

original_fee_entry_id.meaning: for a refund or closing application, the fee entry being refunded or applied (foreign key -> loan_fee_ledger); empty on charges

disclosure_id.meaning: primary id of the disclosure record

customer_id.meaning: borrower the disclosure was delivered to (foreign key -> customers)

disclosure_form.meaning: which TRID document the record is

disclosure_sequence.meaning: 1 for the first document of this form on the file, 2 for the first revision, and so on

issued_date.meaning: date the document was delivered in person, sent through the e-sign portal or placed in the mail; for an intent to proceed, the date it was given

delivery_method.meaning: how the document was delivered or how the intent to proceed was given

received_date.meaning: date the borrower received the document: the e-sign acknowledgment or in-person date, or for mail the date deemed received under the mailbox rule

coc_reason.meaning: changed circumstance relied on for a revised Loan Estimate or corrected Closing Disclosure; none for initial documents

coc_documented_date.meaning: date Larkspur received the information establishing the changed circumstance; empty when coc_reason is none

apr.meaning: annual percentage rate disclosed; empty on an intent to proceed

note_rate.meaning: interest rate disclosed; empty on an intent to proceed

total_closing_costs.meaning: total closing costs (Loan Costs plus Other Costs) disclosed

lender_credit_amount.meaning: lender credits disclosed, shown as a positive amount

nonrecurring_closing_costs.meaning: borrower-paid one-time closing costs disclosed (Loan Costs sections A, B and C plus taxes and government fees in section E), excluding discount points

prepaid_items_total.meaning: prepaid items and initial escrow payment disclosed (Other Costs sections F and G)

discount_points_amount.meaning: discount points disclosed in section A, in dollars

zero_tolerance_total.meaning: sum of the disclosed charges in the zero-tolerance bucket (Larkspur charges, transfer taxes, services the borrower could not shop for)

ten_percent_tolerance_total.meaning: sum of the disclosed charges in the 10 percent aggregate bucket (recording fees plus shoppable services from Larkspur's written provider list)

condition_id.meaning: primary id of the condition record

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file the condition is on (foreign key -> loan_files)

condition_class.meaning: whether the condition must be cleared before closing documents are drawn or before funding

issued_date.meaning: date the underwriter issued the condition (on a cleared/waived record: the issue date of the source condition)

due_date.meaning: date the borrower's documents are due (issued date plus the program's condition response days)

document_date.meaning: date printed on the document supplied to satisfy the condition (statement date, paystub date); empty when not applicable

resolved_date.meaning: date the condition was cleared or waived; empty on the issued record

source_condition_id.meaning: on a cleared or waived record, the issued condition it resolves (foreign key -> loan_conditions); empty on the issued record

waiver_reason.meaning: basis for a waiver; none on issued and cleared records

cure_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the tolerance cure entry

customer_id.meaning: borrower owed the cure (foreign key -> customers)

tolerance_bucket.meaning: TRID tolerance bucket that was exceeded

baseline_disclosure_id.meaning: Loan Estimate whose amounts are the good-faith baseline (foreign key -> loan_disclosures)

final_disclosure_id.meaning: Closing Disclosure whose amounts exceeded the baseline (foreign key -> loan_disclosures)

cure_date.meaning: date the cure was assessed or paid

source_cure_entry_id.meaning: on a payment entry, the assessed cure it pays (foreign key -> loan_tolerance_cures); empty on the assessment

lock_id.meaning: primary id of the rate lock commitment

customer_id.meaning: borrower who holds the lock (foreign key -> customers)

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file the lock protects (foreign key -> loan_files)

variant_name.meaning: lock product, written as the official lock name (its term)

status.meaning: lifecycle status of the lock (basis: lock lifecycle.states)

lock_requested_date.meaning: date the initial lock request was logged

lock_date.meaning: date the lock desk confirmed the lock (the pricing date); empty while pending

original_expiration_date.meaning: expiration date set at confirmation, before any extension; empty while pending

lock_expiration_date.meaning: current expiration date after every extension or relock; empty while pending

lock_price_points.format: points, 3 decimals (percent of the loan amount; positive is a cost to the borrower, negative a credit)
lock_price_points.meaning: net price currently locked for the locked rate, including the term adjustment and any repricing

loan_amount_at_lock.meaning: total loan amount the lock was priced on; basis for every point-to-dollar conversion on the lock

float_down_used.meaning: whether the one-time float-down has been exercised on this lock

lock_cost_balance.meaning: extension, relock and float-down costs booked on the lock and not yet waived or settled at closing; equals the sum of the lock_cost account deltas

deposit_balance.meaning: lock deposit held and not yet credited, refunded or forfeited; equals the sum of the lock_deposit account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the lock record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the lock reached cancelled or delivered; empty otherwise

lock_request_id.meaning: primary id of the logged lock desk request

lock_id.meaning: lock the request concerns (foreign key -> rate_locks)

request_type.meaning: what was asked of the lock desk

request_channel.meaning: how the request reached the lock desk

request_date.meaning: date the request was time-stamped by the lock desk system

request_time.meaning: time the request was time-stamped by the lock desk system

requested_term_days.meaning: lock term or extension length asked for; 0 when not applicable

rate_sheet_price_points.format: points, 3 decimals (percent of the loan amount; positive is a cost to the borrower, negative a credit)
rate_sheet_price_points.meaning: price of the requested rate on the Larkspur rate sheet in effect at the request time stamp, before any term adjustment

lock_pricing_id.meaning: primary id of the lock pricing entry

extension_days.meaning: days added by an extension; 0 on other entries

larkspur_borne_days.meaning: extension days whose cost Larkspur bears (complimentary or appraisal-delay days); 0 on other entries

extension_seq.meaning: 1 for the first extension on the lock, 2 for the second, and so on; 0 on other entries

cost_points.format: points, 3 decimals (percent of the loan amount; positive is a cost to the borrower, negative a credit)
cost_points.meaning: cost of the entry in points of loan_amount_at_lock

cost_amount.meaning: cost of the entry in dollars, positive; points times loan_amount_at_lock divided by 100, rounded to the cent

cost_bearer.meaning: who bears the cost; larkspur-borne entries book 0.00

new_expiration_date.meaning: lock expiration date after the entry; empty when the entry does not move it

new_rate.meaning: note rate after a float-down or relock; empty otherwise

source_pricing_id.meaning: for a waiver or closing settlement, the pricing entry it offsets (foreign key -> lock_pricing_events); empty otherwise

lock_deposit_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the deposit entry

lock_id.meaning: lock the deposit secures (foreign key -> rate_locks)

source_deposit_entry_id.meaning: for a credit, refund or forfeiture, the collected deposit entry it disposes of (foreign key -> lock_deposits); empty on collection

lock_dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the dispute record

filed_date.meaning: date the dispute was filed (on a resolution record: the filing date of the source dispute)

claimed_request_date.meaning: date on which the borrower says the lock request was made; empty when not applicable

claimed_rate.meaning: rate the borrower says was requested; empty when not applicable

disputed_pricing_id.meaning: pricing entry the dispute is about, for extension or relock disputes (foreign key -> lock_pricing_events); empty otherwise

resolution.meaning: outcome; pending on the filing record

resolved_date.meaning: date the dispute was decided; empty on the filing record

matched_request_id.meaning: logged lock request relied on by the decision (foreign key -> lock_requests); empty when none

source_dispute_id.meaning: on a resolution record, the filing record it decides (foreign key -> lock_disputes); empty on the filing record

appraisal_order_id.meaning: primary id of the appraisal order

customer_id.meaning: borrower on whose loan the appraisal is ordered (foreign key -> customers)

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file the appraisal supports (foreign key -> loan_files)

variant_name.meaning: appraisal report type ordered, written as the official report name

status.meaning: lifecycle status of the order (basis: appraisal lifecycle.states)

order_reason.meaning: why the order exists: a first valuation, an appraisal transferred from another lender, a required second appraisal, or a replacement for an expired appraisal

ordered_date.meaning: date the order was placed with the appraisal management company

rush_requested.meaning: whether the borrower asked for rush turn time at order

due_date.meaning: date the completed report is promised: ordered date plus the standard or rush turn time in business days, moved only for borrower-caused access delays

inspection_date.meaning: date the appraiser inspected the property (or completed the desktop analysis); empty until then

completed_date.meaning: date the completed report was received by Larkspur; empty until then

delivered_to_borrower_date.meaning: date a copy of the completed report was delivered to the borrower; empty until then

appraised_value.meaning: market value concluded in the report as last revised; empty until completed

cu_risk_score.meaning: Collateral Underwriter risk score returned for the report; empty when not scored

gross_living_area_sqft.meaning: gross living area of the subject property as reported

site_acres.meaning: site size of the subject property in acres

subject_to_completion.meaning: whether the value is subject to completion or repairs, requiring a final inspection

seller_acquisition_date.meaning: date the seller acquired the subject property, from the title commitment; empty for refinances

seller_acquisition_price.meaning: price the seller paid when acquiring the subject property; empty for refinances

timing_waiver_signed_date.meaning: date the borrower signed the waiver of the three-day appraisal delivery timing; empty if no waiver

fee_balance.meaning: appraisal charges collected from the borrower on this order and not refunded; equals the sum of the appraisal_fees account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the order record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the order was cancelled; empty otherwise

appraisal_fee_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the appraisal fee entry

customer_id.meaning: borrower charged or refunded (foreign key -> customers)

fee_component.meaning: which appraisal charge the entry concerns

amount.meaning: entry amount, always positive; event_type gives the direction

payment_method.meaning: card or account charged or refunded

original_fee_entry_id.meaning: for a refund, the charge entry refunded (foreign key -> appraisal_fee_ledger); empty on charges

refund_reason.meaning: why a refund was issued; none on charges

rov_id.meaning: primary id of the reconsideration-of-value record

appraisal_order_id.meaning: order whose value is challenged (foreign key -> appraisal_orders)

customer_id.meaning: borrower who requested the reconsideration (foreign key -> customers)

submitted_date.meaning: date the request was submitted (on a decision record: the submission date of the source request)

comparables_count.meaning: number of alternative comparable sales the borrower supplied

decision.meaning: outcome; pending on the submission record

decided_date.meaning: date the appraiser's response was received; empty on the submission record

revised_value.meaning: value after reconsideration when the decision is value_changed; empty otherwise

source_rov_id.meaning: on a decision record, the submission it decides (foreign key -> appraisal_reconsiderations); empty on the submission

credit_award_id.meaning: primary id of the closing cost credit award

customer_id.meaning: borrower who holds the credit (foreign key -> customers)

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file the credit is reserved against (foreign key -> loan_files)

variant_name.meaning: credit program, written as the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle status of the credit (basis: credit lifecycle.states)

eligibility_basis.meaning: the qualifying fact the credit was reserved on

heroes_occupation.meaning: occupation verified for a Hometown Heroes credit; none for every other program

partner_builder_name.meaning: legal name of the partner builder on the purchase contract for a Builder Partner credit; empty otherwise

reserved_date.meaning: date the credit was reserved on the loan file

verified_date.meaning: date eligibility was verified and the award amount fixed; empty until then

expiration_date.meaning: date after which an unapplied credit expires: reserved date plus the program's validity days, plus any extension

basis_loan_amount.meaning: base loan amount on the loan file when the award amount was fixed; basis for percentage credits

award_amount.meaning: credit amount fixed at verification (0.00 for the closing guarantee until a payout is owed)

guarantee_closing_date.meaning: closing date guaranteed under the On-Time Closing Guarantee (the purchase contract closing date at enrollment); empty for other programs

docs_complete_date.meaning: date the borrower delivered the last document Larkspur requested before closing, for the closing guarantee; empty until then

credit_balance.meaning: credit booked and not yet applied, reduced or forfeited; equals the sum of the credit_value account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the credit record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the credit reached applied, expired, forfeited or revoked; empty otherwise

credit_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the credit ledger entry

credit_award_id.meaning: credit award the entry belongs to (foreign key -> closing_credits)

entry_amount.meaning: entry amount, always positive; event_type gives the direction

cost_category.meaning: for an application entry, the cost category on the Closing Disclosure the credit pays; none on other entries

disclosure_id.meaning: Closing Disclosure on which the credit was applied (foreign key -> loan_disclosures); empty on other entries

reduction_reason.meaning: why value left the credit without being applied; none on award, payout and application entries

source_entry_id.meaning: for an application, reduction or forfeiture, the award or payout entry it draws on (foreign key -> credit_ledger); empty on awards and payouts

closing_id.meaning: primary id of the closing and funding engagement

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file being closed (foreign key -> loan_files)

lock_id.meaning: rate lock the loan closes under (foreign key -> rate_locks); empty when floating

variant_name.meaning: closing method, written as the official closing method name

status.meaning: lifecycle status of the closing (basis: funding lifecycle.states)

property_state.meaning: state of the subject property, which decides wet or dry funding and remote notarization availability

settlement_agent_name.meaning: title or escrow company conducting the closing, as named on the closing instructions

estimated_funding_date.meaning: funding date assumed on the Closing Disclosure for prepaid interest

docs_drawn_date.meaning: date the closing package was drawn and sent; empty until then

docs_expiration_date.meaning: last date the drawn package may be signed; empty until drawn

signing_date.meaning: date the borrower signed the note (consummation); empty until then

rescission_applies.meaning: whether the transaction carries the three-day right of rescission

rescission_expiration_date.meaning: last day of the rescission period (rescission is possible until midnight of this day); empty when rescission does not apply

disbursement_date.meaning: date the funding wire was sent and interest began to accrue; empty until funded

first_payment_date.meaning: due date of the first monthly payment; set at funding

poa_approved_date.meaning: date Larkspur approved the power of attorney for a power of attorney closing; empty otherwise

esign_consent_date.meaning: date the borrower gave E-SIGN consent for electronic closing documents; empty if none

prepaid_interest_balance.meaning: prepaid interest collected from the borrower at closing and not refunded; equals the sum of the prepaid_interest account deltas

funded_balance.meaning: funds wired to the settlement agent and not returned; equals the sum of the disbursed_funds account deltas

closing_fee_balance.meaning: closing-method, courier, wire, redraw and review fees charged and not reversed; equals the sum of the closing_fees account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the closing record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date the closing reached funded, rescinded or cancelled; empty otherwise

funding_wire_id.meaning: primary id of the wire entry

wire_date.meaning: date the wire was sent or the return received

wire_time.meaning: time the wire was released or the return received

federal_reference_number.meaning: Fedwire IMAD reference of the wire exactly as issued

return_reason.meaning: why funds came back; none on outgoing wires

source_wire_id.meaning: for a return, the outgoing wire returned (foreign key -> funding_wires); empty otherwise

interest_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the prepaid interest entry

interest_from_date.meaning: first day of interest covered by the entry

interest_through_date.meaning: last day of interest covered by the entry

interest_days.meaning: days of interest in the entry, both ends counted

daily_interest_amount.meaning: per diem interest used: loan amount times note rate divided by the day-count basis, rounded to the cent

interest_amount.meaning: entry amount, positive; event_type gives the direction

refund_reason.meaning: why a refund was issued; none on charges

source_interest_entry_id.meaning: for a refund, the charge entry corrected (foreign key -> funding_interest_ledger); empty on charges

closing_fee_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the closing fee entry

reversal_reason.meaning: why a fee was reversed; none on charges

source_fee_entry_id.meaning: for a reversal, the fee entry reversed (foreign key -> funding_fee_ledger); empty on charges

funding_dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the funding dispute record

filed_date.meaning: date the dispute was filed (on a resolution record: the filing date of the source dispute)

disputed_entry_id.meaning: interest or fee entry disputed, when the dispute is about one entry; empty otherwise

resolution.meaning: outcome; pending on the filing record

resolved_date.meaning: date decided; empty on the filing record

refund_amount.meaning: amount refunded or reversed by the decision; 0.00 when denied

source_dispute_id.meaning: on a resolution record, the filing record it decides (foreign key -> funding_disputes); empty on the filing record

customer_id.meaning: borrower the pre-approval is for (foreign key -> customers)

agent_customer_id.meaning: buyer's real estate agent named by the borrower (foreign key -> customers); empty if none

variant_name.meaning: pre-approval level, written as the official level name

target_loan_program.meaning: loan program the pre-approval was sized for

requested_date.meaning: date the borrower asked for the pre-approval

issued_date.meaning: date the pre-approval was issued or last renewed; empty until issued

expiration_date.meaning: last day the pre-approval and its letters are valid; empty until issued

credit_pull_date.meaning: date of the credit report the pre-approval rests on

credit_score.meaning: representative credit score from that report

down_payment_pct.meaning: down payment the borrower plans, as a percent of the purchase price

max_purchase_price.meaning: largest purchase price supported, rounded down to the level's increment

agent_sharing_authorized.meaning: whether the borrower has authorized Larkspur to share letters and expiration with the named agent and to take letter requests from that agent

held_rate.meaning: rate held under a Lock & Shop rate hold; empty when none

rate_hold_expiration_date.meaning: last day of the rate hold; empty when none

hold_fee_balance.meaning: rate hold fee paid and not yet credited, refunded or forfeited; equals the sum of the rate_hold_fee account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the pre-approval record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date it reached converted, declined or withdrawn; empty otherwise

letter_id.meaning: primary id of the pre-approval letter

preapproval_id.meaning: pre-approval the letter is issued under (foreign key -> preapprovals)

letter_seq.meaning: 1 for the first letter under the pre-approval, 2 for the next, and so on (a voiding record repeats the voided letter's number)

letter_date.meaning: date on the letter (on a void record: the date voided)

letter_purchase_price.meaning: purchase price stated on the letter

property_address.meaning: property address on a property-specific letter exactly as on the offer, or TBD for a general letter

recipient_agent_customer_id.meaning: agent the letter was sent to (foreign key -> customers); empty when sent only to the borrower

void_reason.meaning: why a letter was voided; none on issued letters

source_letter_id.meaning: on a void record, the letter voided (foreign key -> preapproval_letters); empty otherwise

hold_fee_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the rate hold fee entry

preapproval_id.meaning: pre-approval holding the rate (foreign key -> preapprovals)

source_hold_fee_entry_id.meaning: for a credit, refund or forfeiture, the fee entry disposed of (foreign key -> preapproval_hold_fees); empty on collection

loan_file_id.meaning: loan file bought down (foreign key -> loan_files)

variant_name.meaning: buydown product, written as the official product name

note_rate.meaning: note rate of the loan the buydown applies to

loan_amount.meaning: total loan amount the buydown is computed on

monthly_pi_note_rate.meaning: monthly principal and interest at the note rate

subsidy_amount.meaning: temporary buydown subsidy required (sum of the monthly payment reductions); 0.00 for permanent buydowns

points_cost.meaning: cost of the discount points for a permanent buydown; 0.00 for temporary buydowns

funded_date.meaning: date the subsidy or points were paid at closing; empty until funded

first_payment_date.meaning: first payment due date of the loan, from which subsidy draws begin; empty until funded

subsidy_balance.meaning: subsidy held in the custodial account and not yet drawn or refunded; equals the sum of the buydown_subsidy account deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the buydown record was opened

closed_date.meaning: date it reached completed, terminated_early or cancelled; empty otherwise

subsidy_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the subsidy entry

payment_number.meaning: loan payment number a draw supports (1 = first payment); 0 on funding and refund entries

refund_reason.meaning: why subsidy left other than by a draw; none on funding and draws

source_entry_id.meaning: for a refund, the funding entry it returns (foreign key -> buydown_subsidy_ledger); empty otherwise

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record, one per customer

customer_id.meaning: customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller's identity has been verified for this customer; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: customer handed to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
